name: Plymouth Indiana Mini 2025
information:
This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. If you are interested in attending your first competition, we recommend signing up for [Chicagoland Newcomers 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChicagolandNewcomers2025#general-info),

As space in the venue is limited, you may bring a maximum of one guest.

Plymouth Indiana Mini 2025 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org).
